'''Krullian''' was an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] being with [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin and at least six red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] who fought as a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] in [[the Cauldron]], an arena on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]. The fighter used two double-ended bladed [[Melee weapon/Legends|weapons]] and wore blue [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]] and matching [[Armor/Legends|bracers]], with red [[Clothing/Legends|sashes]] connecting the pauldrons to a ring at the center of Krullian's chest.<ref name="Gladiators" />

==Behind the scenes==
Krullian was a character created for [[Chapter 6 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|Chapter 6]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' micro-series,<ref name="Bonus">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume One|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' Volume One]] {{C|Posters & Artwork}}</ref> which aired on [[November 14]], [[2003]];<ref name="TV">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-vi-276612|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars - Season 1, Episode 6: Chapter VI}}</ref> however, the character did not make it into the final cut of the episode.<ref name="CW">{{CW|6}}</ref> Despite this, concept art of the character was included in a stills gallery on the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume One|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' Volume One]] DVD<ref name="Bonus" /> released on [[March 22]], [[2005]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/about/news/news20041206.html|text=''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' Volume 1 Coming to DVD}}</ref> Krullian was then confirmed to exist [[in-universe]] in "[[Galactic Gladiators: Great Warriors of Star Wars|Galactic Gladiators: Great Warriors of ''Star Wars'']]," a [[StarWars.com]] blog post written by [[Tim Veekhoven]] and [[Kevin Beentjes]] and published on [[August 5]], [[2014]].<ref name="Gladiators" />
